sentences.text: Use the phonetic alphabet to spell names and numbers: Alfa, Bravo, Charlie, Delta and so on.
Say over when you want a reply, and out when the conversation is finished.
Do radio checks on a working channel or an automated radio-check service, never on channel sixteen.
Make initial calls on sixteen or nine, then switch to a working channel to talk.
And never make a false distress call.
It’s a federal crime that can bring fines, prison and the cost of the search.
